roles.hint_not_owner: What each role may do. Only owners change roles.
roles.built_in_hint: A built-in role cannot be changed.
roles.editor_hint: Members with this role get exactly these permissions, from their next click on.
roles.delete_description: Only a role nobody has can be removed.

team.disabled_toast: {name} can no longer use this shop
login.sso_failed: Single sign-on did not work. Try again.

sso.name: Button name
sso.secret_kept: Saved; leave empty to keep it

sso.domains_hint: People with these email domains may sign in this way. Separate several with commas.
sso.default_role_hint: Someone signing in for the first time joins the shop with this role.
sso.enforce: Only allow single sign-on for these domains
sso.enforce_hint: Passwords and emailed sign-in links stop working for them.
sso.remove_description: People of its domains sign in with a password or an emailed link again.
integrations.description: Connect OpenRent to the other software your shop uses. Invoices, payments and customers are sent over as they happen.
integrations.none: No integrations are installed. Integrations come with plugins.
integrations.plugin_off_hint: Turn the plugin on on the Plugins page first.
integrations.not_ready: Enter the app’s client ID and secret on the plugin’s settings first:
integrations.connect_failed: The connection did not go through. Try again.
integrations.catch_up_started: Earlier records are on their way
integrations.queued: {count, plural, one {# record queued} other {# records queued}}
integrations.disconnect_description: Nothing more is sent. What was already sent stays there.
journal.title: Accounting journal
journal.hint: Double-entry bookings for invoices, credit notes, payments and deposits, ready to import into any accounting software.
integrations.accounting_moved: Accounting systems (Xero, QuickBooks, Zoho Books) are set up on their own page, with the journal and account codes.
accounting.description: What OpenRent booked, and what reached your accounting system. The books themselves stay in your accounting system.
accounting.none_hint: OpenRent still books every invoice, credit note and payment; download them from the Journal tab, or connect Xero, QuickBooks or Zoho Books to send them there.
accounting.not_sending: Connected, but nothing is sent yet: finish the account mapping and start sending.
accounting.failed_hint: Entries the system refused; see why
accounting.mismatches_hint: Records that differ or were removed in the accounting system
accounting.booked_hint: Every entry OpenRent booked, by kind
accounting.unbooked: {count, plural, one {# movement is being booked} other {# movements are being booked}}
accounting.mark_handled_hint: Use this when you booked it in the accounting system yourself. Nothing more is sent for it.
accounting.step_system_hint: Where your books are kept. One system per shop.
accounting.needs_app: Needs the app’s client ID and secret
accounting.step_connect_hint: Create an app in the {name} developer portal with the redirect URL below, enter its credentials, then sign in.
accounting.redirect_hint: Add this exact URL to the app in {name}.
accounting.step_organisation_hint: Your sign-in gave access to several organisations; choose the one for this shop.
accounting.organisation_hint: Changing it starts the mapping over.
accounting.step_mapping_hint: Choose where each kind of revenue, money and tax goes in {name}. The lists come from {name} itself.
accounting.step_start_hint: Entries booked from the start date on are sent, oldest first; new ones follow within a minute.
accounting.send_from_hint: Use the first day the accounting system does not have yet.
accounting.started: {count, plural, one {Sending; # entry queued} other {Sending; # entries queued}}
accounting.disconnect_description: Nothing more is sent. OpenRent keeps booking; what was sent stays in the accounting system.
accounting.connecting_hint: Sign in again to finish connecting.
accounting.journal_hint: Every booked entry, double-entry and balanced, with your account codes, for any accounting software.
accounting.codes_hint: Used in the journal from now on; entries already booked keep their codes.
accounting.books_hint: When OpenRent issues invoices, and up to when the books are closed.
accounting.invoice_when_hint: Without invoices the books show payments but no revenue.
accounting.lock_date_hint: Anything that happens on an earlier date is booked on the day after it.
accounting.import_payments_hint: Payments entered in {name} (e.g. from a bank feed) against invoices OpenRent sent are added to their orders every 15 minutes.
staff_notice.staff_accounting_issue: {count, plural, one {# record changed in {name}} other {# records changed in {name}}}
customer.terms.title: Account terms
customer.terms.description: For business customers who book first and pay the invoice later.
customer.terms.on_account_hint: Bookings are confirmed without payment; the invoice is due after the payment terms.
customer.terms.schedule.monthly: One a month for all finished bookings
customer.terms.po_required_hint: A booking with something left to pay cannot be confirmed without one.
order.po_required: Enter the customer's purchase order number
order.on_account_hint: On account: the invoice is due {days} days after it is issued
order.credit_limit.title: Over the credit limit
customer.account.send_link_hint: The link is valid for a week, also before the first booking.
order.billing.hint: Each period is invoiced when it starts; a saved card is charged, else the customer gets a payment link.
settings.provider_hint: Online payments, refunds and card holds for deposits.
settings.provider_hint.stripe: Cards, wallets and more in the storefront's own payment form, with refunds and card holds for deposits.
settings.provider_hint.mollie: Customers pay on Mollie's page with the methods your Mollie profile offers (iDEAL, Bancontact, cards, SEPA…).
settings.provider_hint.paypal: Customers approve the payment in PayPal and come back to their booking.
settings.providers_several: Several providers are on; checkout uses {name}. Turn the others off to choose another.
settings.cart_reminders_hint: One email to people who left items and their email in the cart, with a link back to it and one to stop them.
settings.cart_reminders_after: Hours after the cart was left
bundle.slots_hint: Give components the same choice group (e.g. Lens) to make them alternatives: the customer picks one. Components without a group always come along.
relations.title: Goes with
relations.description: Accessories are offered with this product when booking online; related products are shown with it.
relations.accessory_hint: Customers tick them to add them with this product.
relations.related_hint: Shown as links on this product's page.
relations.often_none: Worked out from bookings each week; nothing yet.
external.title: Rented in
external.description: Stock you rent from a supplier for some dates. It can be booked then only.
external.saved_resolved: Stock rented in; {count, plural, one {# overbooking is} other {# overbookings are}} covered now
external.cancel_text: The stock from {supplier} can no longer be booked.
reports.save_hint: Keeps this report with its filters. With a schedule it is emailed at 07:00 shop time: daily, on Mondays or on the 1st of the month.
reports.saved_none: No saved reports yet. Choose a report and its filters, then save it.
reports.schedule_to: {schedule} to {count, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}}
reports.send_queued: {count, plural, one {The report is on its way to # recipient} other {The report is on its way to # recipients}}
reports.delete_text: {name} will no longer be emailed. The report itself stays available.
email.texts_hint: Booking updates by SMS or WhatsApp go to customers who asked for them at checkout, in their account or on their customer page. WhatsApp is used when a customer wants both.
email.texts_setup: Enter the plugin's account details under

import.map_hint: Choose what each column of the file holds. The choice is kept for the next file with the same columns.

migration.title: Move from another system
migration.hint: Read your customers, products, stock and bookings, check what would change, then bring it all in at once. Running it again later only adds what is new.
migration.source_hint.booqable: Customers, products with their price, and bookings. The API key is in Booqable under Settings → API keys.
migration.source_hint.snipeit: Asset models become products, assets their units. Make an API token in Snipe-IT under your account → Manage API keys.
migration.source_hint.shelf: Export your assets from Shelf.nu as CSV. Assets with the same name become one product with a unit each.
migration.booqable_company_hint: The first part of your Booqable address: "rentals" for rentals.booqable.com
migration.key_hint: Used once to read your data, and not shown again.
migration.batch_hint: Nothing has changed yet. Look through each list, then bring it all in.
migration.fix_errors: Fix the rows with problems in the other system, or here in OpenRent, then read it again.
